qe: What is the basic structural and functional unit of the human Nervous System?
qh: मानव तंत्रिका तंत्र की मूलभूत संरचनात्मक और कार्यात्मक इकाई क्या है?
e: Concept: Nervous system ka poora kaam ek chhoti si cell se hota hai - Neuron (nerve cell) - jo message (nerve impulse) ko bijli ki tarah aage bhejti hai; iski teen khaas cheezein hoti hain: dendrites (signal lena), soma/cyton (cell body) aur axon (signal aage bhejna). Isliye neuron ko nervous system ki structural aur functional unit kehte hain. Baaki teen doosre system ke units hain: Sarcomere (muscle ki sabse chhoti ikai), Alveolus (phephde me gas exchange), Nephron (kidney ka unit). Exam point: 'Nervous system ka unit = Neuron (nerve cell)'.

qe: The microscopic junctional gap across which nerve impulses pass from one neuron to the next via neurotransmitters is a:
qh: दो न्यूरॉन्स के बीच का वह सूक्ष्म अंतराल क्या कहलाता है जहाँ से तंत्रिका आवेग रासायनिक रूप से गुजरते हैं?
e: Concept: Ek neuron ka signal doosre neuron tak seedha nahi pahunchta - dono ke beech ek chhota sa gap hota hai jise Synapse (synaptic cleft) kehte hain; yahan ek neuron se neurotransmitter (rasayan) nikalta hai jo doosre neuron ke upar chipak kar signal aage badhata hai. Yahi jagah dawaon (jaise neend ki dawa, depression ki dawa) ka kaam karne ka main adda hai. Baaki teen alag parts hain: Axon hillock (axon ka shuruaat), Telomere (chromosome ka cap), Node of Ranvier (myelin ke beech ka gap). Exam point: 'Do neurons ke beech ka gap/rasayanik junction = Synapse (synaptic cleft)'.

qe: Which major part of the human brain functions as the seat of higher intellect, conscious thought, memory, and reasoning?
qh: मानव मस्तिष्क का कौन सा भाग ज्ञान, बुद्धि, विचार, तर्क और स्मृति (मेमोरी कार्ड) का मुख्य केंद्र होता है?
e: Concept: Brain ka sabse bada aur sabse upar wala hissa Cerebrum (Telencephalon) hota hai, jismein do hemispheres (bayen-daayen) hote hain aur uski bahari parat (cortex) me suljhe hue folds (gyri/sulci) hote hain - yahi sochne, samajhne, yaad rakhne, seekhne aur marzi se kaam karne ka center hai (intelligence, memory, reasoning). Baaki teen neeche ke hisse hain: Cerebellum (balance), Medulla (saans/BP), Pons (saans ka rhythm). Exam point: 'Sochne-samajhne/memory ka seat = Cerebrum (cerebral cortex)'.

qe: Which diencephalic master center operates as the body's internal thermostat, regulating hunger, thirst, and body temperature?
qh: मस्तिष्क का कौन सा भाग शरीर के आंतरिक तापमान (थर्मोस्टेट), भूख, प्यास और भावनाओं को नियंत्रित करता है?
e: Concept: Hypothalamus brain ke andar ek chhota sa hissa hai jo poore sharir ke andar ke 'adhunik thermostat aur control room' ki tarah kaam karta hai - yahi bhookh, pyaas, neend, garmi-thand (temperature), aur hormone release (pituitary ke through) ko control karta hai; isliye ise 'master of autonomic functions' kehte hain. Baaki teen alag hisse hain: Thalamus (sensation ka relay), Corpus callosum (dono hemispheres ko jodne wala), Epithalamus (pineal gland wala hissa). Exam point: 'Sharir ka thermostat (bhookh-pyaas-temperature) = Hypothalamus'.

qe: Which part of the brain functions as the sensory relay station, filtering external sensations like heat, cold, and pain?
qh: मस्तिष्क का कौन सा भाग बाहरी वातावरण से आने वाले दर्द, ठंड और गर्मी के संवेदी संकेतों के लिए 'रिले स्टेशन' का कार्य करता है?
e: Concept: Thalamus diencephalon me hai aur ek 'relay station' (sandes chowki) ki tarah kaam karta hai: chamdi/anga se aane wali saari sensory information (garmi, thand, dard, sparsh) pehle yahan aati hai, yahan se chhan kar cerebrum ke sahi hisse tak bheji jati hai (sirf smell - ghraan - isi chakkar se bachta hai). Baaki teen alag hain: Hypothalamus (thermostat/hormone), Cerebellum (balance), Medulla (saans/BP). Exam point: 'Sensations ka relay/switch point = Thalamus'.

qe: Which metencephalic structure located at the base of the skull coordinates voluntary muscle movements, precision, and body balance?
qh: मस्तिष्क का कौन सा भाग मांसपेशियों की गति का समन्वय करता है और शरीर का संतुलन (Posture) बनाए रखता है?
e: Concept: Sar ke base par mathhe ke peeche ek chhota, jhuramutta (folded) dhaancha hota hai - Cerebellum - jo sharir ka balance aur 'fine-tuned' movement sambhalta hai: cycle chalana, seedhiyan chadhna, likhna, chammach se khaana - in sabki precision aur posture isi ki den hai; isme kharabi ho to chalne me dagmagahat aur kaam me kampan (ataxia) hota hai. Baaki teen alag hain: Medulla (saans/BP), Cerebrum (sochna), Corpus Callosum (jodne wala tract). Exam point: 'Balance aur precision movement = Cerebellum (chhota brain)'.

qe: What is the primary physiological function of the lipid-rich 'Myelin Sheath' wrapping around nerve axons?
qh: तंत्रिका तंतु (Axon) के चारों ओर पाई जाने वाली माइलिन शीथ (Myelin Sheath) का मुख्य कार्य क्या है?
o: Electrical insulation to enable rapid saltatory impulse conduction
e: Concept: Nerve cell ke axon ke upar Myelin Sheath ek moti lipid (charbi wali) chaddar ki tarah chadhi hoti hai - ye ek 'insulator' (bijli ke taar ke plastic) ki tarah kaam karta hai aur signal ko seedha leaping (saltatory conduction) ke roop me tezi se aage bhejta hai (myelinated axon me speed ~100 m/s tak, bina myelin ki slow). Iske saath ye axon ko bhi bachata hai. Baaki teen kaam iske nahi hain: ATP banao (mitochondria), neurotransmitter todna (enzymes/astrocytes), phagocytosis (microglia). Exam point: 'Myelin = insulation + tez saltatory conduction'.

qe: Which caudal brainstem structure controls vital autonomic involuntary actions like cardiac rhythm, respiration, and blood pressure?
qh: मस्तिष्क का कौन सा भाग हृदय की धड़कन, श्वसन की दर और रक्तचाप जैसी महत्वपूर्ण अनैच्छिक क्रियाओं को नियंत्रित करता है?
e: Concept: Brainstem ke sabse neeche wale hisse Medulla Oblongata me wo 'vital centers' hote hain jo bina hamari marzi ke poore jeevan ke buniyaadi kaam chalate hain: dil ki dhadkan (cardiac center), saans (respiratory center), khoon ka dabav (vasomotor center), nigalna, ulti, khaansi aur cheenk - isliye ise 'life ka markaz' kehte hain; is par chot bahut khatarnak hoti hai. Baaki teen ab kaam nahi: Thalamus (relay), Cerebrum (sochna), Cerebellum (balance). Exam point: 'Dhadkan, saans, BP wala auto center = Medulla oblongata (brainstem)'.

qe: Sudden, involuntary reflex actions (such as jerking the hand back from fire) are predominantly processed and integrated by the:
qh: किसी खतरे के प्रति अचानक होने वाली 'प्रतिवर्ती क्रियाएं' (Reflex Actions) मुख्य रूप से किसके द्वारा नियंत्रित होती हैं?
e: Concept: Achanak ho gayi bina soche-paaye harkat (jaise aag se hath kheench lena, ghutne ka bhang) ko reflex action kehte hain; iska faisla utna hi jaldi chahiye, isliye ye signal brain ke bohot pehle spinal cord me hi 'short circuit' (reflex arc) banakar aage bhej diya jata hai - brain ko baad me pata chalta hai. Yahi wajah hai ki foot-path par chubhne wali cheez se pehle hath-peir turant hat jaate hain. Baaki teen alag hain: Cerebrum (sochi samjhi harkat), Cerebellum (balance), Hypothalamus (garmi/bhookh). Exam point: 'Reflex action ka control center = Spinal cord (merurajju)'.

qe: How many pairs of Spinal Nerves emerge from the human spinal cord to innervate the trunk and extremities?
qh: मानव मेरुरज्जु (Spinal Cord) से कुल कितनी जोड़ी स्पाइनल नसें निकलकर शरीर में फैलती हैं?
e: Concept: Spinal cord (merurajju) se 31 jodiyan nerves nikalti hain jo sharir ke dhad (trunk) aur hoye (limbs) ko jaati hain; inka batwara dher, kandhe, kamar, koolhe aur dum ke hisse me hai: 8 Cervical (C), 12 Thoracic (T), 5 Lumbar (L), 5 Sacral (S) aur 1 Coccygeal (Co) = 31 jodiyan. Khaas baat: cervical region (8) me ek vertebra (7) se zyada nerve hoti hai. Baaki teen numbers galat hain (46 koi bhi janwar ka nahi, 24 aur 12 to iske hisse bhi nahi). Exam point: 'Spinal nerves = 31 jodiyan (8C + 12T + 5L + 5S + 1Co)'.

qe: How many bilateral pairs of Cranial Nerves emerge directly from the base of the human brain?
qh: मानव मस्तिष्क से सीधे निकलने वाली क्रेनियल तंत्रिकाओं (Cranial Nerves) की संख्या कितनी होती है?
e: Concept: Dimaag ke base se seedha nikalne wali nerves Cranial nerves kehlati hain - inki kul 12 jodiyan hoti hain (jo aankh, dekhna, sunna, sonagh, chehra, zubaan, nigalna aur dil-pet wagairah ko chalati hain). Ye spinal nerves se alag hain (wo 31 jodiyan hoti hain aur merurajju se nikalti hain). Iske naam yaad rakhne ka classic tarika: 'Oh Oh Oh To Touch And Feel Very Good Velvet Ah Heaven'. Baaki teen numbers doosre parts ka hain: 31 (spinal), 24 (kuch nahi), 10 (vagus ka number). Exam point: 'Cranial nerves = 12 jodiyan (brain base se)'.

qe: What are the three protective connective tissue membranes (Meninges) enclosing the brain and spinal cord, from outer to inner?
qh: मस्तिष्क और मेरुरज्जु को ढकने वाली तीन सुरक्षात्मक झिल्लियों (मेनिन्जेस) का बाहर से भीतर की ओर सही क्रम क्या है?
o: Pia mater, Arachnoid mater, Dura mater
Dura Mater, Arachnoid Mater, and Pia Mater
e: Concept: Brain aur spinal cord ko bahar se teen paraton wali suraksha (Meninges) gherei rehti hai - bahar se andar: Dura Mater (sabse moti, 'tough mother'), Arachnoid Mater (makdi ke jaal jaisi, jisme CSF bhara rehta hai) aur Pia Mater (sabse patli, brain ke fold me saaf chipki). Inke beech ke spaces me CSF hota hai; meningitis me yehi parat soojh jaati hai. Baaki teen options doosri jagah ki paratein hain (pleura-pericardium-peritoneum pet/phephda/dil; endosteum-periosteum-epimysium haddi-muscle) aur aakhri option ulte kram me hai (andar se bahar). Exam point: 'Meninges (bahar->andar) = Dura > Arachnoid > Pia'.

qe: The protective, shock-absorbing fluid that fills the subarachnoid space and cerebral ventricles is:
qh: मस्तिष्क के निलयों और मेनिन्जेस के बीच बहने वाला सुरक्षात्मक द्रव (Shock Absorber) क्या कहलाता है?
e: Concept: Brain ke andar chhote-chhote khokhle kamre (ventricles) hote hain aur meninges ki arachnoid parat ke neeche ek space (subarachnoid space) hota hai - in dono me ek saaf, spast (shock-absorbing) dravya bhara rehta hai jise Cerebrospinal Fluid (CSF) kehte hain; ye brain ko takkar se bachata hai, waste nikalta hai aur brain ko tairta rakhta hai. Ise choroid plexus banata hai aur ye har 4-5 ghante me naya ban jata hai. Baaki teen alag fluids hain: Synovial (joint), Endolymph (kaan ke andar), Blood plasma (khoon ka taral hissa - CSF isse alag aur bilkul saaf hota hai). Exam point: 'Subarachnoid space/ventricles ka cushion fluid = CSF (choroid plexus banata hai)'.

qe: Which cranial nerve (CN X) is the longest and provides primary parasympathetic innervation to the heart, lungs, and digestive tract?
qh: मानव शरीर की सबसे लंबी क्रेनियल तंत्रिका कौन सी है जो मस्तिष्क से निकलकर हृदय, फेफड़ों और आंतों तक जाती है?
e: Concept: Vagus Nerve (10th cranial nerve) sharir ki sabse lambi nerve hai - ye dimag se nikal kar gale, saans ki nali, phephde, dil aur poore paachan-tantra tak jaati hai aur parasympathetic system ka mukhya 'shanti aur paachan' wala signal deti hai (dhadkan dheemi, paachan tez). Isliye ise 'wanderer nerve' kehte hain. Baaki teen alag nerves hain: Facial (chehre ki expression), Trigeminal (chehre ka sparsh/dant/dhev), Optic (dekhna). Exam point: 'Sabse lambi cranial nerve + dil/phephda/pet ka parasympathetic niyantran = Vagus (CN X)'.

qe: Nissl's granules found abundantly in the cyton (soma) and dendrites of neurons are biochemically composed of:
qh: न्यूरॉन के साइटॉन में पाए जाने वाले 'निस्ल के कण' (Nissl's Granules) मुख्य रूप से किससे बने होते हैं?
e: Concept: Neuron ki cell body (cyton/soma) aur dendrites me gol-gol daane dikhte hain jinhe Nissl's granules kehte hain - ye asal me bahut saare Ribosomes aur Rough Endoplasmic Reticulum ka juta hua roop hote hain; inka kaam protein banana hai (jisse neuron ke membrane channel, neurotransmitter enzymes, aur repair material taiyar hote hain) - isliye 'bahut mehnet karne wali' cell me ye aur bhi zyada hote hain. Baaki teen galat hain: Mitochondrial cristae (energy), Lipofuscin (boodhe hone ka pigment), Dense DNA fragments (aisa nahi hota). Exam point: 'Nissl's granules = Ribosomes + Rough ER (protein synthesis ke liye)'.

qe: The thick transverse commissural tract of white matter connecting the left and right cerebral hemispheres is the:
qh: मस्तिष्क के दाएँ और बाएँ गोलार्धों को आपस में जोड़ने वाली तंत्रिका तंतुओं की चौड़ी पट्टी क्या कहलाती है?
e: Concept: Dimaag ke do hemispheres (bayen aur daayen) ko aapas me jodne wala ek mota safed tar (fiber tract) hota hai - Corpus Callosum; ye dono taraf ki information ka 'pull' (bridge) hai, taaki bayen aur daayen haath/pair aur dono aankhon ka kaam ek saath sahi chale. Baaki teen alag structures hain: Arbor Vitae ('life tree' - cerebellum ke andar ki shaakha jaisi safed parat), Infundibulum (hypothalamus-pituitary ka jod), Pons Varolii (medulla ke upar ka safed hissa). Exam point: 'Do cerebral hemispheres ko jodne wala tract = Corpus callosum'.

qe: The motor speech area of the brain coordinating the muscle movements necessary for speech articulation is:
qh: बोलने और शब्दों के उच्चारण को नियंत्रित करने वाला मस्तिष्क के ललाट भाग का क्षेत्र क्या कहलाता है?
e: Concept: Bolne ke liye jabaan, hoth, jabde aur gale ki muscles ko ek tarteeb me chalana hota hai; ye control cerebrum ke frontal lobe me ek khaas jagah se hota hai jise Broca's Area kehte hain. Is jagah chot lagne par mareez bol nahi paata (ya tutle-tutle bolta hai) - par usko samajh aati rehti hai aur wo likhkar apni baat keh sakta hai (isme sirf bolna kharab hota hai). Baaki teen areas alag kaam ke hain: Wernicke (samajhna), Somatosensory strip (sparsh), Visual cortex (dekhna). Exam point: 'Bolne (speech articulation) ka area = Broca's area (frontal lobe) - damage se bol nahi paana'.

qe: Damage to which cortical area in the left temporal lobe impairs language comprehension, resulting in 'Word Salad' speech?
qh: भाषा को समझने और सार्थक वाक्य बनाने से जुड़ा कौन सा क्षेत्र क्षतिग्रस्त होने पर व्यक्ति अर्थहीन शब्द बोलने लगता है?
e: Concept: Bhasha samajhne ka kaam cerebrum ke temporal lobe me ek khaas area - Wernicke's Area - karta hai; ismein chot lagne par mareez bol to leta hai (bolne ki motor shakti theek hoti hai) par uski baat samajh nahi aati aur wo bematlab shabd jod kar 'Word Salad' (word salad) bolta hai; aur doosron ki baat bhi samajh nahi pata. Baaki teen areas alag kaam karte hain: Broca (bolna), Angular gyrus (padhna-likhna), Prefrontal (faisla/planning). Exam point: 'Bhasha SAMJAHNA = Wernicke's area; bolna = Broca's area'.

qe: What is the typical baseline electrical Resting Membrane Potential of an unstimulated human neuron?
qh: एक विश्राम अवस्था वाले न्यूरॉन की झिल्ली का सामान्य विद्युत विभव (Resting Potential) कितना होता है?
e: Concept: Har neuron ki membrane ke andar aur bahar charge ka antar hota hai: bahar zyada positive (Na+) aur andar zyada negative - isi 'resting tension' ko Resting Membrane Potential kehte hain aur healthy neuron me ye lagbhag -70 mV hoti hai. Ye 'taiyaar' halat (polarized) isliye bani rehti hai kyunki andar K+ ions zyada hain, bahar Na+ zyada, aur Na+/K+ pump aur leak channels isse sambhalte hain. Baaki teen values doosre points ke hain: +30 mV peak depolarization, 0 mV beech, -90 mV muscle/cardiac jaisi alag cell ki value. Exam point: 'Resting potential ~ -70 mV (andar negative)'.

qe: The rapid 'Depolarization' spike of a neuronal action potential is driven by the sudden, massive influx of which ion?
qh: तंत्रिका आवेग (Action Potential) शुरू होते ही न्यूरॉन झिल्ली के भीतर किस आयन का तेजी से प्रवेश होता है?
e: Concept: Jab neuron ko stimulus milta hai aur 'threshold' (-55 mV) tak pahunchta hai, to membrane me voltage-gated sodium channels khul jaate hain aur bahar ka Sodium (Na+) ek dum andar toot padta hai - isse andar positive ho jata hai aur voltage tezi se +30 mV tak chadhta hai, isi step ko Depolarization (action potential ka spike) kehte hain. Uske turant baad K+ bahar nikalta hai (repolarization). Baaki teen ions ka aisa kirdar nahi: Cl- andar aakar inhibit karta hai, Mg2+ block karta hai, K+ bahar nikalne se resting halat wapas aati hai. Exam point: 'Depolarization = Na+ ka sudden influx (spike +30 mV); Repolarization = K+ ka efflux'.

qe: The active, ATP-driven Sodium-Potassium Pump maintains neuronal resting potential by transporting:
qh: सोडियम-पोटेशियम पंप (Na+/K+ ATPase) ऊर्जा का उपयोग करके झिल्ली के आर-पार किन आयनों का आदान-प्रदान करता है?
e: Concept: Neuron ke andar ke charge ko barabar rakhne ke liye ek mehnga (ATP kharch) pump chalta rehta hai - Sodium-Potassium Pump (Na+/K+ ATPase): har chakkar me ye 3 Sodium (Na+) ko bahar dhakelta hai aur 2 Potassium (K+) ko andar le aata hai. Isse andar negative aur bahar positive ka antar (resting potential) bani rehti hai aur 'samay ke saath dhakke' wale signal ki capacity bani rehti hai. Baaki teen rates iska ulta/galat hain (2 bahar-3 andar, 1-1, aur 3 andar-2 bahar). Exam point: 'Na+/K+ pump = 3 Na+ bahar, 2 K+ andar (har ATP se)'.

qe: Saltatory conduction refers to the rapid, efficient propagation of action potentials jumping between the unmyelinated:
qh: माइलिन युक्त तंत्रिकाओं में विद्युत आवेगों का एक अंतराल से दूसरे अंतराल पर छलांग लगाकर तेजी से आगे बढ़ना क्या कहलाता है?
e: Concept: Myelin sheath poori axon par nahi, chhote-chhote tukdon me chadhi hoti hai; in tukdon ke beech ke chhote khule gap ko Nodes of Ranvier kehte hain. Ion channels sirf inhi gaps par hote hain, isliye signal ek-ek gap par 'jump' karta hai (saltatory conduction) - jaise ghar ke raaste ke bijli ke khambon me tar banata tayer karta ho; isse speed 10-50 guna badh jati. Baaki teen alag parts hain: Dendritic spines (branch ke daane), Synaptic boutons (signal bhejne wala bulb), Axon hillock (axon ka start). Exam point: 'Saltatory conduction = Nodes of Ranvier par jump (myelin ke gaps)'.

qe: Which cortical lobe of the cerebrum houses the primary visual reception and processing cortex?
qh: मस्तिष्क के सेरीब्रम का कौन सा पश्च भाग (Lobe) मुख्य रूप से दृष्टि और आँखों से मिले संकेतों को संसाधित करता है?
e: Concept: Dimaag ke chaar lobe hote hain aur dekhne (visual reception aur processing) ka kaam sabse peeche wale hissa - Occipital Lobe - karta hai; yahin optic nerve se aane wali information 'photo' ki tarah sanjoyi aur pehchani jati hai. Isliye occipital lobe ki chot se andha hona ya kam dikhna hota hai. Baaki teen lobes alag kaam karte hain: Frontal (sochna/bolna/planning), Parietal (sparsh, dard, temperature), Temporal (sunna/smell/hippocampus se memory). Exam point: 'Dekhna (vision) = Occipital lobe'.

qe: Which part of the internal ear contains the three fluid-filled Semicircular Canals responsible for dynamic rotational equilibrium?
qh: मानव कान का कौन सा आंतरिक भाग सिर के घूर्णन और शारीरिक संतुलन (Dynamic Balance) को बनाए रखने के लिए जिम्मेदार है?
e: Concept: Kaan ke andar teen hisse hote hain - bahari kaan (sound catch karna), madhya kaan (kann ke parde ko hilana) - aur andar wala kaan (internal ear), jisme do alag system hote hain: sunna (cochlea) aur balance. Balance ke liye teen aadhe gol (semicircular canals) hote hain jo har plane me (age-peeche, bayen-daayen, jhidka) liquid (endolymph) bharne se hilte hain aur unke hair cells brain ko batate hain ki sir kis taraf ghoom raha hai - isliye isse 'dynamic rotational equilibrium' kehte hain. Baaki teen shravan/kaan ke hisse hain: Cochlear duct (sunna), Auditory meatus (bahari nali), Tympanic cavity (kanneri ki jaga). Exam point: 'Balance/ghoomna batane wale semicircular canals = internal ear (vestibular apparatus)'.

qe: The true, sensory transducing organ of hearing located on the basilar membrane within the cochlea is the:
qh: आंतरिक कान के कोक्लीआ (Cochlea) के भीतर ध्वनि कंपनों को तंत्रिका संकेतों में बदलने वाला वास्तविक श्रवण अंग कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Cochlea (ghonghi jaisi andar wali nali) ke andar ek 'basilar membrane' par ek chhota organ hota hai - Organ of Corti - jisme hoth hair-cells (roi) hote hain; sound ki lehar wahan pahunchti hai to yeh hairs mudte hain aur nerve signal banti hai jo auditory nerve se brain tak jaati hai. Yehi asli 'sunne wala ang' hai (isi ke hair cells shade hone se sunai kam ho jata hai). Baaki teen doosre kaam ke hain: Cupula (balance), Crista ampullaris (ghoomna batana), Macula lutea (aankh ka pit - dekhna). Exam point: 'Sunne ka asli transducer = Organ of Corti (cochlea ke basilar membrane par)'.

qe: The central depression in the retina packed exclusively with densely clustered cones, providing the sharpest visual acuity, is the:
qh: आँख के रेटिना पर स्थित वह कौन सा पीला बिंदु (Fovea Centralis) है जहाँ केवल शंकु कोशिकाएं होती हैं और दृष्टि सबसे स्पष्ट होती है?
e: Concept: Aankh ke retina (parde) ke bilkul beech me ek chhota sa gehra khuha hota hai - Fovea centralis (Macula lutea ke beech me) - jahan con cells (range pehchanne wali) sabse zyada aur kas kar bhare hote hain; isliye jis cheez ko 'dhyan se' dekhna ho, hum seedha usi par nazar jamaate hain - sabse tez aur saaf dikhne (visual acuity) wali jagah yahi hai. Baaki teen alag hisse hain: Ciliary margin, Optic disc (blind spot), Canal of Schlemm (aankh ka drain). Exam point: 'Sabse tez dikhne wali jagah (only cones) = Fovea centralis / macula lutea'.

qe: Why is the anatomical 'Optic Disc' region of the retina universally designated as the 'Blind Spot'?
qh: रेटिना के उस क्षेत्र को 'अंध बिंदु' (Blind Spot) क्यों कहा जाता है जहाँ से ऑप्टिक नर्व आँख से बाहर निकलती है?
o: The crystalline lens blocks light rays from striking it
It is covered by dark melanin granules
It completely lacks photoreceptor cells (both rods and cones)
e: Concept: Retina ke jis chhoti jagah se optic nerve aankh se bahar nikalta hai, wahan koi bhi photoreceptor (na rod na cone) nahi hota - isliye agar koi cheez ki image gate hue wahan pad jaye, to wo dikhai nahi deti; isi liye us jagah ko Blind Spot (andha dhabba) kehte hain. Dhoka aisa hai ki humein kabhi 'andha dhabba' nazar nahi aata kyunki brain use doosre aankh ki image se bhar deta hai. Baaki teen kaaran galat hain: lens/hawan/melanin/vessels ki wajah se ye andha nahi hota. Exam point: 'Blind spot = Optic disc (wahan rod/cone nahi hote - optic nerve nikalne ki jagah)'.

qe: The auditory Eustachian tube equalizes air pressure between the ambient atmosphere and the:
qh: यूस्टेशियन नलिका (Eustachian Tube) कान के पर्दे के दोनों ओर वायुदाब को संतुलित करने के लिए मध्य कान को किससे जोड़ती है?
e: Concept: Kaan ki madhya (middle) cavity me ek patli nali jati hai - Eustachian tube (nalki) - jo naak ke peeche wale gale (nasopharynx) tak pahunchti hai; iska kaam kann ke parde (tympanic membrane) ke dono taraf hawa ka dabav barabar rakhna hai - tabhi kanneri theek se kampti hai. Isliye jahaz me/jaate-pahaad par kaan band hone par nigalna/chewing se ye nali khulti hai aur pressure theek ho jata hai. Baaki teen iske doosre sire nahi hain (larynx, trachea, esophagus) - ye gale ki alag naliyan hain. Exam point: 'Eustachian tube = kaan ki hawa ka pressure naak ke gale (nasopharynx) se barabar karti hai'.

qe: Which purplish-red conjugated photopigment present in the membrane discs of retinal Rods requires Vitamin A for synthesis?
qh: रेटिना की बेलनाकार (Rod) कोशिकाओं में मंद प्रकाश में देखने के लिए कौन सा वर्णक होता है जो विटामिन A से बनता है?
e: Concept: Aankh ke retina me do tarah ki cells hoti hain - rods (dekhna dhundhle roshni me) aur cones (range). Rods me ek khaas photopigment hota hai Rhodopsin (visual purple) jo roshni par tootata hai aur signal banata hai; ye banne ke liye Vitamin A chahiye - isliye Vitamin A ki kami se 'night blindness' (raat me kam dikhna) hoti hai. Baaki teen alag photopigments hain: Porphyropsin (kuch machhli/janwar), Melanopsin (sleep/garmi sense), Iodopsin (cones me range dekhne ke liye). Exam point: 'Rods ka photopigment = Rhodopsin (Vitamin A se banta hai; kami = rat-andhapan)'.

qe: Which neuroglial cells form the insulating myelin sheath around nerve fibers in the Central Nervous System (CNS)?
qh: केंद्रीय तंत्रिका तंत्र (मस्तिष्क और मेरुरज्जु) में न्यूरॉन्स के चारों ओर माइलिन शीथ बनाने वाली सहायक कोशिकाएं कौन सी हैं?
e: Concept: CNS (brain aur spinal cord) ke andar nervous ke aas-paas myelin banane ka kaam Oligodendrocytes karte hain (ek cell kai axons ko myelin deti hai); iske ulat PNS (bahari nerves) me ye kaam Schwann cells karte hain (ek cell ek hi axon ke ek hisse ko). Baaki teen glial cells ke alag kaam hain: Schwann cells - PNS ka myelin, Microglia - safai (phagocytosis), Astrocytes - BBB + support. Exam point: 'CNS ka myelin = Oligodendrocytes; PNS ka myelin = Schwann cells'.

qe: Star-shaped neuroglial cells with perivascular end-feet that physically establish and maintain the protective Blood-Brain Barrier (BBB) are:
qh: मस्तिष्क में रक्त-मस्तिष्क अवरोधक (Blood-Brain Barrier) का निर्माण करने वाली तारे के आकार की कोशिकाएं क्या कहलाती हैं?
e: Concept: Brain ko khoon me ghule zeher/ bacteria/kuch dawaon se bachane ke liye ek chhani (filter) hoti hai - Blood-Brain Barrier (BBB). Isko banane aur sambhalne wala kaam khaas tara ke star-shaped glial cells - Astrocytes - karte hain: unke 'perivascular end-feet' (paid) khoon ki naliyon ko chaaron taraf se jakad kar tight junctions banate hain, jisse sirf chune hue padarth hi dimaag me ja paate hain. Baaki teen glial cells alag kaam karte hain: Ependymal (CSF), Microglia (safai/inflammation), Oligodendrocytes (myelin). Exam point: 'Blood-Brain Barrier banane wale = Astrocytes'.

qe: Which non-neuronal glial cells divide uncontrollably and account for nearly 90% of primary clinical Brain Tumors (Gliomas)?
qh: मस्तिष्क में न्यूरॉन्स के विभाजन न होने के बावजूद होने वाला 'ब्रेन ट्यूमर' मुख्य रूप से किन सहायक कोशिकाओं के अनियंत्रित विभाजन से होता है?
e: Concept: Dimaag me neurons ke saath glial cells (neuroglia) bhi hote hain jo support, myelin, safai ka kaam karte hain - khaas baat ye hai ki mature neurons ke ulat inme division ki kshamta bani rehti hai, isliye jab kuch genetic change se ye bekaabu ho kar badhti hain to dimaag ke cancer (glioma) bante hain - aur yehi wajah hai ki brain tumors ka lagbhag 90% glioma (glial origin) hote hain. Baaki teen options is bal ka hissa nahi hain: Endothelial pericytes (khoon ki nali ki cells), Mature unipolar neurons (divide nahi karte), Choroid plexus lining (CSF banati hai). Exam point: 'Brain tumor ka ~90% = glioma (glial cells se banta hai)'.

qe: Why do mature adult human neurons completely lack the biological capacity to undergo mitotic cell division or regenerate after deep injury?
qh: गंभीर चोट लगने के बाद मानव मस्तिष्क के न्यूरॉन्स दोबारा विभाजित होकर ठीक क्यों नहीं हो पाते?
o: Complete absence of functional Centrosomes (Centrioles) required for spindle assembly
Absence of genetic DNA in the nucleus
e: Concept: Embryo me neurons pehle badi tayyari se divide karke ban jaate hain, par janm ke baad unme division ki capacity khatam ho jati hai (G0 phase me chale jaate hain) - khaas wajah: unke paas kaam karne wale Centrosome/Centrioles nahi hote, aur spindle (jisme chromosome alag hote hain) banane ke liye yahi chahiye. Isliye dimaag/spinal cord me gehri chot ya neuron marna bahut khatarnak hota hai - wapas nahi bharte (ye nuksaan permanent ho jata hai). Baaki teen kaaran galat hain: energy, DNA ka na hona, membrane ka na hona (wo to hote hain). Exam point: 'Mature neurons divide nahi karte = centrosomes na hone se'.

qe: Which primary neurotransmitter operates as the principal inhibitory signaling molecule in the mammalian central brain?
qh: मानव मस्तिष्क में तंत्रिका उत्तेजना को शांत करने और चिंता कम करने वाला मुख्य निरोधात्मक (Inhibitory) न्यूरोट्रांसमीटर कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Brain ke andar ka mukhya 'inhibitory' (rokne wala) neurotransmitter GABA (Gamma-Amino-Babutyric Acid) hai - iska kaam hai neuron ko 'shant' karna (jaise brakes), taaki dimaag me bina kaaran 'aag' na lag jaye. Isliye ame saanti wali dawaon (antiepileptic, benzodiazepines) ka sidha nishana GABA ka system hota hai; iski kami se mirgi, bechaini aur chid-chidapan hota hai. Baaki teen 'excitatory' ya alag kaam ke hain: Glutamate (sabse aam excitatory), Norepinephrine (arousal), Acetylcholine (muscle/memory). Exam point: 'Brain ka mukhya inhibitory neurotransmitter = GABA'.

qe: Which inhibitory neurotransmitter serves as the primary post-synaptic inhibitory mediator within the Spinal Cord?
qh: मेरुरज्जु (Spinal Cord) में मोटर न्यूरॉन्स को शांत रखने वाला प्राथमिक निरोधात्मक न्यूरोट्रांसमीटर कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Spinal cord (merurajju) me sensory information aur motor commands ke beech ek 'shanti' (gate) system chahiye; wahan ka mukhya inhibitory neurotransmitter Glycine hai - ye spinal cord ke interneurons (Renshaw cells) aur motor neurons ke aas-paas post-synaptic inhibition karta hai, jisse signal ka andhera/ulta na ho (aur reflex sahi tarah se chhun jaye). Isliye strychnine (zeher) glycine ko rok kar tjhhatke (convulsion) paida karta hai. Baaki teen alag kirdar ke hain: Serotonin (mood/neend), Glutamate (brain ka excitatory), Dopamine (reward/movement). Exam point: 'Spinal cord ka inhibitory neurotransmitter = Glycine'.

qe: Neurotransmitter release from pre-synaptic vesicles into the synaptic cleft is triggered biochemically by the rapid influx of which cation?
qh: सिनैप्टिक नोब से न्यूरोट्रांसमीटर रसायनों के विमोचन को ट्रिगर करने के लिए किस आयन का अंदर प्रवेश अनिवार्य है?
e: Concept: Jab action potential neuron ke end (pre-synaptic terminal) par pahunchta hai, to wahan voltage-gated Calcium (Ca2+) channels khul jate hain aur Calcium andar aata hai; yahi Calcium vesicles (jisme neurotransmitter bhara hai) ko membrane se jodkar unhe bahar (synaptic cleft me) chhodne ka signal deta hai - yani Calcium hi 'dimaghi rasayan chhutne ka switch' hai. Baaki teen ions ye kaam nahi karte: Na+ action potential banata hai, K+ resting wapas laata hai, Cl- inhibition karta hai. Exam point: 'Neurotransmitter release ka trigger = Ca2+ ka influx'.

qe: Which primary neurotransmitter acts at the motor endplate of all skeletal neuromuscular junctions to trigger voluntary muscular contraction?
qh: तंत्रिका-पेशी जोड़ (Neuromuscular Junction) पर मांसपेशियों के संकुचन को सक्रिय करने वाला मुख्य न्यूरोट्रांसमीटर कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Jab hum koi marzi se harkat karte hain to brain se signal motor neuron ke through skeletal muscle par pahunchta hai, aur wahan ek khaas junction - neuromuscular junction (motor endplate) - par Acetylcholine (ACh) chhutkar muscle ki membrane par lage receptors se judta hai aur muscle sikud jata hai. Isliye ACh ko 'voluntary movement ka messenger' kehte hain (aur dawaon/zeher se iska block paralysis karta hai). Baaki teen alag kaam ke neurotransmitters hain: Dopamine (movement control/mood), Serotonin (mood), GABA (inhibition). Exam point: 'Skeletal muscle contraction ke liye motor endplate par = Acetylcholine (ACh)'.

qe: Which clinical disorder results from the progressive autoimmune destruction of the myelin sheath in the Central Nervous System?
qh: केंद्रीय तंत्रिका तंत्र में माइलिन शीथ के नष्ट होने से दृष्टि और मांसपेशियों की कमजोरी वाली ऑटोइम्यून बीमारी कौन सी है?
e: Concept: Multiple Sclerosis (MS) me sharir ki apni immunity (immune system) galti se CNS (brain/spinal cord) ke neurons ke myelin (insulation) par hamla kar deti hai aur use todti hai - isse signal aana-jaana dheema ya ruk jata hai aur lakshan ubharte hain: kamzori, jhunjhuni, chalne-dikhne me dikkat, dobara theek hona (relapse-remission). Baaki teen diseases alag hain: Parkinson's (dopamine neurons/movement), ALS (motor neurons ki degeneration), Alzheimer's (memory/soch). Exam point: 'CNS myelin ka autoimmune destruction = Multiple Sclerosis (MS)'.

qe: Neurodegenerative loss of cholinergic neurons in the basal forebrain and cerebral cortex producing severe memory loss is:
qh: मस्तिष्क में एसिटाइलकोलीन की कमी और एमिलॉयड प्लाक जमने से याददाश्त खोने वाली बीमारी कौन सी है?
e: Concept: Alzheimer's disease me brain ke basal forebrain aur cortex ke cholinergic (Acetylcholine wale) neurons dheere-dheere mar jaate hain, aur unke beech 'plaques aur tangles' (amyloid-beta aur tau protein) jama hote hain; isse sabse pehle nayi baat yaad rakhne ki shakti kam hoti hai, phir soch samajh aur bolna bhi kam; ye budhape ki sabse aam dimaghi bimari hai. Baaki teen alag hai: Huntington (chorea - khaas harkat), Parkinson (kampan/movement), CJD (prion - fast fatal). Exam point: 'Cholinergic neurons ki loss + memory loss = Alzheimer's disease'.

qe: The specialized, vascularized, clear epithelial capillary network lining the ventricles that secretes Cerebrospinal Fluid (CSF) is the:
qh: मस्तिष्क के निलयों में स्थित वह कौन सा रक्त केशिकाओं का जाल है जो सेरेब्रोस्पाइनल द्रव (CSF) का निरंतर स्राव करता है?
e: Concept: Brain ke ventricles (kamre) ke andar ek khaas patli aur khoon ki naliyon bhari parat hoti hai - Choroid Plexus - jo CSF (cerebrospinal fluid) banati aur chhorti hai; yahi asli 'factory' hai jahan se poora brain tairta rehta hai aur takkar se bachta hai. Baaki teen alag structures hain: Arachnoid granulation (CSF ko brain se nikalne wala valve), Corpus striatum (movement se juda hissa), Circle of Willis (brain ki khoon nadiyon ka ghera). Exam point: 'CSF banane wali jhopdi = Choroid plexus (ventricles me)'.

qe: Pathological obstruction of CSF drainage pathways causing ventriculomegaly and dangerously elevated intracranial pressure is:
qh: मस्तिष्क में सेरेब्रोस्पाइनल द्रव (CSF) का निकास अवरुद्ध होने से सिर के बड़े होने की स्थिति को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Concept: Brain me bana kaafi CSF (paani) agar apne raste (ventricles, arachnoid granulations) se nikal nahi paata - gale me barh jaata hai - to ventricles phool jaate hain aur intracranial pressure (dimag ka dabav) khatarnak taur par barh jata hai; ye bimari Hydrocephalus ('dimag me paani') kehlati hai; bade sar wale bachche me isi ki wajah se sar badh jata hai aur ilaaj me shunt (nali) lagayi jati hai. Baaki teen alag hain: Encephalomalacia (brain tissue ka naram pana/marna), Microcephaly (chhota sar), Meningismus (gardan akadna - sign). Exam point: 'CSF ka drain rukna + ventricles ka phoolna = Hydrocephalus'.

qe: The thick, transparent, completely avascular anterior convex window of the eyeball that refracts light and gets oxygen directly from air is the:
qh: आँख का वह पारदर्शी और रक्त-वाहिका रहित सामने का भाग कौन सा है जो सीधे हवा से ऑक्सीजन लेता है और नेत्रदान में प्रत्यारोपित होता है?
e: Concept: Aankh ke aage ka saaf, patla aur bilkul khoon ki naliyon wala (avascular) hissa Cornea hai - ye 'khaas window' ki tarah light ko andar jaane deta hai aur sabse zyada refraction (65-75%) yahin hota hai; khaas baat: ismein khoon ki naliyan na hone ke kaaran ye oxygen seedha hawa se aur aas-khol ke aansu (tear) se leta hai - isliye contact lens me cornea ko saans lene dena (oxygen permeable) zaroori hota hai. Baaki teen alag hisse hain: Ciliary body (muscle), Sclera (safed parat), Iris (range wali). Exam point: 'Aankh ka saaf window + sabse zyada refraction = Cornea (avascular, oxygen hawa se)'.

qe: The tough, opaque, white outer fibrous protective coat of the eyeball covering the posterior five-sixths is the:
qh: आँख की पुतली के चारों ओर दिखाई देने वाला कठोर, अपारदर्शी सफेद सुरक्षात्मक आवरण क्या कहलाता है?
e: Concept: Aankh ke bahari parat ke do hisse hain: aage ka saaf hissa cornea aur peeche ka safed, mota, apardh (opaque) hissa Sclera - yahi 'aankh ka safed dhabba' dikhta hai; ye ander ke nazuk hisson (retina, lens) ko bahari chot se bachata hai aur aankh ko aakar deta hai; isi sclera par aankh ki bahari muscles chipki hoti hain jo aankh ko ghumati hain. Baaki teen alag paratein hain: Cornea (saaf aage), Choroid (beech wali khoon-nali wali parat), Retina (sabse andar ka parda). Exam point: 'Aankh ki safed bahari moti parat = Sclera'.

qe: The clear, gelatinous, structural hydrogel filling the large posterior vitreous chamber between the lens and retina is the:
qh: लेंस और रेटिना के बीच आँख के पिछले बड़े कक्ष में भरा रहने वाला पारदर्शी जेली जैसा द्रव क्या कहलाता है?
e: Concept: Aankh ke aage wale chhote kamre me paani (aqueous humour) bharta hai jo ban-kar nikalta rehta hai (kharab nikalne par glaucoma hota hai); par aankh ke peeche wala bada hissa ek geeli, saaf, jelly jaisi cheez se bhara hota hai - Vitreous Humor (vitreous body) - jo aankh ka aakar banaye rakhti hai, retina ko chipkaye rakhti hai aur light ke raste me aati hai (ye shaadi ke baad nayi nahi banti, wohi rehti hai). Baaki teen alag fluids hain: Perilymph/Endolymph (kaan ke andar), Aqueous humour (aage wala hissa). Exam point: 'Aankh ke peeche ki jelly = Vitreous humor (aage ka taral = Aqueous humor)'.

qe: In Hypermetropia (Farsightedness), where parallel light rays focus behind the retina, optical correction requires which lens?
qh: दूर दृष्टि दोष (Hypermetropia) में पास की वस्तुएं साफ न दिखने पर चश्मे में किस लेंस का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Concept: Hypermetropia (door ki nazar theek, paas ki kam) me aankh ki goli (lens) ki 'taakat' kam hoti hai ya aankh chhoti hoti hai, isliye light rays retina par milne ke bajaye retina ke peeche jatli hain; ise theek karne ke liye ek outer lens chahiye jo rays ko 'jodkar' andar laaye - Convex (converging) lens. Baaki teen alag hain: Cylindrical (astigmatism), Bifocal (presbyopia), Concave (myopia ka ilaaj - ulta kaam). Exam point: 'Hypermetropia (paas kam dikhna) = Convex lens; Myopia (door kam) = Concave lens'.

qe: In Myopia (Nearsightedness), where distant images are brought to a focal point in front of the retina, optical correction requires a:
qh: निकट दृष्टि दोष (Myopia) में दूर की वस्तुएं धुंधली दिखने पर चश्मे में किस लेंस का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Concept: Myopia (nearsightedness - door ki cheez dhundhli) me aankh lambi hoti hai ya lens/comea ki power zyada, isliye door se aane wali parallel light rays retina se pehle hi (aage) mil jaati hain; ise theek karne ke liye aisi lens chahiye jo rays ko pehle faila de (diverge) - Concave (diverging) lens; iske baad rays retina par milti hain aur door ki cheez saaf dikhti hai. Baaki teen alag hain: Cylindrical (astigmatism), Prismatic (double vision), Convex (hypermetropia). Exam point: 'Myopia (door kam dikhna) = Concave lens (-ve power); Hypermetropia = Convex lens'.

qe: Age-related progressive loss of crystalline lens accommodation elasticity, making near reading vision difficult past age 40, is:
qh: उम्र बढ़ने पर आँख के लेंस का लचीलापन कम होने से होने वाला 'जरा दृष्टि दोष' क्या कहलाता है?
e: Concept: Umar ke saath lens ka 'lacchak' (elasticity) kam ho jaata hai aur ciliary muscle kamzor - isliye paas ki cheez (padhna, likhna) focus karne me dikkat hoti hai aur cheez door karne par thik dikhta hai; ye 40 saal ke baad lagbhag har insaan me hota hai, isliye ise Presbyopia kehte hain - ise theek karne ke liye Bifocal lens (upar door + neeche paas) lagti hai. Baaki teen alag bimariyan hain: Astigmatism (cornea ka aakar kharab), Trachoma (aankh ka infection), Glaucoma (aankh ke andar ka dabav). Exam point: 'Umar (40+) ke saath paas ki nazar kam = Presbyopia (bifocal lens)'.

qe: The massive cranial nerve coordinating facial cutaneous sensory perception and somatic motor innervation to muscles of mastication (chewing) is:
qh: चेहरे की संवेदनाओं और भोजन चबाने वाली मांसपेशियों को नियंत्रित करने वाली सबसे बड़ी क्रेनियल तंत्रिका कौन सी है?
e: Concept: Chehre ki saari usni garmi-thand, sparsh, dard, aur data (daant) ki vase, aura masoodhr (muscles) ka control paanchvi cranial nerve - Trigeminal Nerve (CN V) - karti hai; ye brain ki sabse moti cranial nerve hai aur iski teen branches hoti hain: Ophthalmic (aankh/mathe), Maxillary (gaal/upper jabda), Mandibular (jabda/dant/chewing). Baaki teen alag nerves hain: Facial (VII - chehre ki bhav-mudra), Hypoglossal (XII - jabaan), Glossopharyngeal (IX - nigalna). Exam point: 'Chehre ka sensation + chewing = Trigeminal nerve (CN V, sabse badi cranial nerve)'.

qe: The specialized autonomic cranial nerve governing somatic motor control of intrinsic and extrinsic tongue movements is the:
qh: जीभ की हरकतों, बोलने और निगलने को नियंत्रित करने वाली 12वीं क्रेनियल तंत्रिका कौन सी है?
e: Concept: Baarah cranial nerves me aakhri wali - Hypoglossal Nerve (CN XII) - poore jabaan (tongue) ke andar ke muscles (intrinsic) aur doosre muscles ko marzi se chalane ka kaam karti hai (bolna, chabana, nigalna). Iski kharabi par jabaan ek taraf hai ho jati hai aur bolne/nigalne me dikkat hoti hai. Baaki teen alag kaam karti hain: Accessory (XI - kandhe/gale ki muscle), Vagus (X - dil/phephda/pet), Glossopharyngeal (IX - nigalna/garam, kas hus). Exam point: 'Jabaan ki harkat = Hypoglossal nerve (CN XII)'.

qe: The major network of cervical and thoracic spinal nerve roots (C5 to T1) providing motor and sensory control to the upper limb is the:
qh: हाथों और कंधों की मांसपेशियों को नियंत्रित करने वाला रीढ़ की नसों का जाल क्या कहलाता है?
e: Concept: Sharir ke 'network' ko samjho: spinal nerves ki jhern (roots) ek jagah ikattha ho kar 'jaal' (plexus) banati hain aur usse saare nerves hoye (limbs) me phailti hain. Haath ke liye nerve roots C5 se T1 tak mil kar ek jaal banate hain - iska naam Brachial Plexus hai; isi se haath ki saari motor aur sensory nerves nikalti hain (aur janm ke waqt kandhe ki bharai se iska khichav 'brachial palsy' karta hai). Baaki teen doosre ilaake ke plexuses hain: Lumbar/Sacral (pair/pairo), Cervical (gardan). Exam point: 'Haath (upper limb) ka plexus = Brachial plexus (C5-T1)'.

qe: The clinical neurological reflex phenomenon where stimulation of the sole of an adult's foot causes dorsiflexion of the hallux is:
qh: वयस्कों में पैर के तलवे को सहलाने पर अँगूठे का ऊपर उठना किस केंद्रीय तंत्रिका विकार को दर्शाता है?
e: Concept: Kisi bhi bade bachche/adult ke pair ke tale ko kisi nukili cheez se upar se sehene par, sidha anguthe ke baad 'upar murna' (dorsiflexion) aur baki ungliyan pai ki tarah failna - ye ek abnormal sign hai jise Babinski's sign kehte hain; iska matlab hai ki corticospinal (motor) rasta kharab hai (brain/spinal cord ki bimari/stroke). Dhyaan rakhna: chhote bachche me ye reflex normal hai (unka dimaghi rasta abhi pura bana nahi). Baaki teen alag signs hain: Brudzinski (meningitis me gardan modne par pair mudna), Patellar (ghutne ka reflex), Romberg (ankh band karke khade hone par dagmagana). Exam point: 'Babinski sign (extensor plantar) adult me = upper motor neuron ki chot'.

qe: The physiological perception of visceral pain projected to a dermatome distant from the affected visceral organ (e.g., left arm pain in angina) is:
qh: आंतरिक अंग के दर्द का शरीर के किसी दूर के हिस्से में महसूस होना (जैसे दिल के दौरे में बाएँ हाथ का दर्द) क्या कहलाता है?
e: Concept: Sharir ke andar ke angon (dil, pet, kidney) ke dard ka signal brain me aata hai par brain un andon ko sidha 'map' nahi kar pata - kyunki un ango ke nerve signals usi spinal cord ke hisse me aate hain jahan chamdi ke kisi khaas hisse (dermatome) ke signals aate hain; isliye dimag aksar chamdi wale hisse me dard 'project' kar deta hai. Sabse mashhoor misaal: dil ki bimari (angina/heart attack) me sirf chhati me nahi, bayen haath, jaw ya kandhe me dard mehsoos hota hai - ise Referred Pain kehte hain. Baaki teen alag hain: Radicular (nerve root ka dabav), Psychogenic (mansik), Phantom (kate ang ka dard). Exam point: 'Visceral dard ka chamdi (dermatome) me mehsoos hona = Referred pain (angina me left arm)'.

qe: Complete motor paralysis affecting one lateral half of the human body, commonly precipitated by a contralateral cerebral stroke, is:
qh: मस्तिष्क आघात (Stroke) के कारण शरीर के एक तरफ के आधे हिस्से में होने वाले पक्षाघात (लकवा) को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Concept: Brain me ek taraf ki motor rasta (corticospinal tract) cross kar jata hai (decussation), isliye dimag ke ek taraf ki chot sharir ke ULTE hisse ko paralyze karti hai - aur poori ek taraf (ek haath + ek pair + chehra) ka paralysis Hemiplegia kehlata hai; sabse aam kaaran brain ka stroke (khoon ka thakka/bahar) hai. Baaki teen alag hain: Monoplegia (sirf ek ang), Quadriplegia (chaaron hoye), Paraplegia (dono pair). Exam point: 'Sharir ka aadha (ek taraf) paralysis = Hemiplegia (ulta taraf brain chot se)'.

qe: The involuntary physiological process of the ciliary muscle altering lens curvature to focus sharply on near versus distant objects is:
qh: पास और दूर की वस्तुओं को स्पष्ट देखने के लिए सिलियरी मांसपेशियों द्वारा आँख के लेंस की फोकस दूरी बदलने की क्षमता क्या कहलाती है?
e: Concept: Sharir ke andar ki lens (chashme wali) apna aakar badal kar paas aur door ki cheezon par focus karti hai; ye kaam ciliary muscle ke sikudne-dhil hone se hota hai - ise Visual Accommodation kehte hain; paas ki cheez dekhne ke liye ciliary muscle sikudta hai (lens moti), door dekhne ke liye dheela (lens patli). Iska control parasympathetic nerve karti hai (aur baad me elastic kam hone par presbyopia hota hai). Baaki teen alag cheezein hain: Astigmatic correction (chashma ka silender), Pupillary miosis (pudli ka chhota hona), Convergence (dono aankhon ka andar aana). Exam point: 'Lens ka aakar badal kar focus karna = Accommodation (ciliary muscle ke through)'.

qe: A sudden traumatic transection or complete severing of the spinal cord in the cervical or thoracic spine results immediately in:
qh: रीढ़ की हड्डी (Spinal Cord) के टूट जाने या कट जाने पर क्या गंभीर शारीरिक परिणाम होता है?
o: Permanent irreversible sensorimotor Paralysis below the injury level
e: Concept: Spinal cord (merurajju) brain ko sharir se jodne wala 'cable' hai; agar ye poora kate ya phate (kaat ho jaye - khaas kar gardan (cervical) ya chhati (thoracic) ke hisse me), to us jagah ke neeche ka poora signal aana-jaana band ho jata hai aur mareez ko us level ke neeche hamesha ke liye laghbhag poora sensorimotor paralysis (harkat aur ehsaas dono ka jana) ho jata hai - ye permanent hota hai kyunki neurons wapas ban nahi paate (centrosome ki kami). Baaki teen galat hain: haddi ka badhna (aisa nahi), sirf thodi dair ka sunnpan, aur sirf sunai kam hona - ye spinal cord transection ke asar nahi hain. Exam point: 'Spinal cord ka poora naata toot jana = injury level ke neeche permanent paralysis (recovery nahi)'.
